title: Affine derived sections transport pullback adjunction mates
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism between affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], with independent sheaf and module derived localization universes [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_S)$. Write $F_g$ for the fixed left adjoint to derived global scalar restriction [lem-sc-mixed-global-extension-adjunction]. There is an isomorphism $a:F_g(R\Gamma(S,E))\cong R\Gamma(T,Lg^*E)$ such that for every $L\in D(\mathcal O_T)$ and every $\theta:Lg^*E\to L$, the transpose under scalar extension/restriction of $R\Gamma(S,\operatorname{adj}_g(\theta))$ followed by the normalized Leray comparison [lem-sc-mixed-global-sections-direct-image-iso] equals $a\circ R\Gamma(T,\theta)$. Here $\operatorname{adj}_g$ is the sheaf pullback/direct-image adjunction [lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction]. There is no perfectness or flatness hypothesis.

proof.text: Identify the affine schemes with spectra of their global rings. Use the affine quasi-coherent derived equivalence and a K-flat module resolution of E. The tilde/pullback comparison computes Lg*E as derived extension of scalars. The underived section adjunction unit is x to 1 tensor x; deriving it and localization uniqueness identify the units, giving a unit-compatible isomorphism a for the fixed mixed scalar extension adjunction.

Transpose a.hom followed by RΓ_T(theta) under the fixed scalar extension adjunction. The unit compatibility in step 1 and naturality identify this with RΓ_S of the sheaf pullback adjunct of theta, followed by the normalized derived Leray map. Its right-derived-unit equation fixes this comparison. Injectivity of homEquiv gives the required equality for every L and theta. Localization uniqueness transports these equations independently in the two morphism universes.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_mixedAffineSectionsPullbackMate
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (R : Type u) [Ring R], HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] [IsAffine T]
    (g : T ⟶ S) (E : schemeDerivedCategory S)
    (hE : schemeDerivedQCohProperty S E) :
    ∃ a : (mixedGlobalExtension g).obj ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections S).obj E) ≅
        (schemeDerivedGlobalSections T).obj ((derivedPullback g).obj E),
      ∀ (L : schemeDerivedCategory T) (theta : (derivedPullback g).obj E ⟶ L),
        ((mixedGlobalExtensionAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm
            ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections S).map
                ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction g).homEquiv E L theta) ≫
              (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso g).hom.app L) =
          a.hom ≫ (schemeDerivedGlobalSections T).map theta
